elements.element: The exit obligations apply on both expiry and termination.
elements.evidence: Paragraph 4(c)(v) expressly applies “following termination or expiration.”
Kubient must, at Customer’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance period is “up to six (6) months following termination or expiration.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must “return or deliver to Customer” all defined Customer Data in its possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Return or delivery is required “within thirty (30) days of such request.” The position does not specify a different deadline anchor or prohibit a customer-request mechanism.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format is “a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies a standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After return or delivery, Kubient must “thereafter delete such Customer Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion after returning and deleting Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Kubient must certify the deletion in writing after the return-or-delivery obligation.

elements.element: The exit obligations apply on both expiry and termination.
elements.evidence: Paragraph 4(c)(v) expressly covers both “termination or expiration.”
Kubient is expressly required to provide reasonable transition assistance at Customer’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least the 90-day fallback period.
elements.evidence: The six-month assistance window exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Kubient must return or deliver all defined Customer Data to Customer in a machine-readable format.

elements.element: The data export is provided within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The operative deadline is thirty days after Customer’s request.

result.reason: The redline implements every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback assistance period. The customer-request mechanism is customer-controlled and does not contradict either stated position; the 30-day data deadline runs from that request. The priority sentence is appropriately limited to Customer Data and is necessary to prevent the existing return-or-destroy option from defeating the new return-before-deletion process.
